messages:
Maya: Quick sync — the yearly "sprintcamp" weekend is locked for Sep 7–8. Need session owners, facilitators, and A/V leads by EOD Thursday. Sketch below, please react or +1 if you're taking something. :spiral_calendar:

Oliver: +1 dates. I'll own the 'capacity & cost' session and the Dedicated-customer review slot.

Tess: I can take launch criteria workshop and help with breakout guides.

Ben: Happy to facilitate Day 1 morning (intros + framing + icebreakers). Can someone share a simple slide template?

Maya: @Ben thanks — slide template here: https://intra.redwood/sprintcamp/templates (placeholder). @Samira can you confirm hybrid room and Zoom host/co-host?

Samira: On it. Room 402 is reserved for both days. Zoom account needs a co-host; I can be the remote co-host. Will schedule AV test Fri 16:00.

Jenna: Do we have final attendee list? PMs + Eng leads + Growth + 1 sales rep?

Oliver: Current attendee master in the doc (I'll add new hires): https://intra.redwood/docs/sprintcamp/attendees. Quick question — breakout size: 6-8 vs 10? Smaller for deeper tradeoffs.

Tess: prefer 6-8, and propose two parallel tracks: product (prioritization + launch) and infra (capacity + reliability).

Maya: Agreed. Draft schedule below — please call out any conflicts.

```
Day 1:
09:00 — Intro + OKR framing (Maya)
10:15 — Capacity & cost session (Oliver)
11:30 — Lunch
13:00 — Breakout track A: Product (Tess lead)
13:00 — Breakout track B: Infra (Oliver lead)
16:00 — Synthesis + decisions (Ben)

Day 2:
09:00 — Launch criteria workshop (Tess)
12:00 — Lunch
13:00 — Roadmap trade-offs + prioritization (group)
15:00 — Wrap + action owners
```

Samira: AV checklist for the test: mics x4, presenter clicker x1, spare HDMI adapters x3, room laptop + Zoom co-host access. @ops-bot can you confirm supplies?

ops-bot: Supplies check scheduled for Fri 16:00. Inventory snapshot: mics=4, clickers=1, adapters=3. Recommend requesting 1 extra clicker.

Ben: For facilitation, please seed the prioritization matrix with 2 prompts: 'customer impact' and 'cost to serve'. I'll design a 15-min calibration exercise so everyone uses the same scale.

Jenna: I'll draft the prompts and pull the top 10 customer asks to seed the matrix. Will share by EOD Thursday.

Oliver: Can we reserve a 30-min slot on Day 2 afternoon for Dedicated customers feedback? They specifically asked for a review of SLA tradeoffs and scaling options.

Tess: That works — slot after lunch would be ideal.

Maya: Action items (please ack):
- Oliver: update attendee doc + add Dedicated customers slide (due Thu noon)
- Tess: launch criteria template + breakout facilitation guide (due Thu EOD)
- Ben: slides + facilitation plan + calibration exercise (due Fri noon)
- Samira & ops-bot: AV test Fri 16:00 and confirm extra clicker
- Jenna: prioritization prompts + customer list (due Thu EOD)

Flag if you can't hit these and we'll reassign. I'll lock the agenda on Friday morning if no objections. :white_check_mark:

Oliver: noted, will update doc today.

Samira: Adding Zoom co-host invites now.

Jenna: Sending draft prompts in ~30m.
